score_axes.static_review: One point per required item only when the finding is grounded in supplied code/data and explains the violated contract. No runtime credit.
score_axes.case_generation: One point per required item mapped to a concrete smallest-level case with setup/action/expected observation and source. Explaining a defect alone is insufficient.
score_axes.evidence_adjudication: One point per required item for correct outcome/method/provenance boundaries with source evidence. Supplied traces are inherited records.
score_axes.runtime_probe: One point per required item only after actual fixture execution and captured runtime evidence. Reasoning, source inspection, recorded traces and mock self-reported PASS score zero execution credit.

gates: Every applicable required item passes independently in every mandatory subcase; no family averaging.
Zero confirmed false product defects on clean variants; missing capabilities are coverage gaps.
Never credit blocked/skipped/code-only/inherited records as fresh runtime PASS.
No regression on an item baseline passed.
One initial paired pass per variant/workflow; any apparent improvement/regression requires two further independent pairs, retaining all outcomes.
Demonstrated gain requires same improvement in all three pairs without retained regression; parity or inconsistent outcomes means effectiveness unproven.
Runtime capability gaps remain in denominator as unexecuted/blocked, not deleted.
Controls C039/C040 retain scope and dispatch count; no irrelevant output/device reference loads.

required: Identify exercise-keyed attempt leakage into p2; cite upsert key.

cases.clean_guard: Do not demand independent content copies.

cases.clean_guard: Administrator is not the only valid actor.

cases.clean_guard: Local display differing from UTC text is not itself a defect.

cases.clean_guard: Do not substitute an unstated accounting definition.

required: Partition checkout evidence by build; original checkout does not verify r2.
Retain unaffected catalog evidence with stated impact basis.
cases.clean_guard: Matching final rerun is reusable; do not restart every case.

runtime_probe.reset: Fresh in-memory revision and independent browser context per arm.

cases.clean_guard: No browser is required to verify this API/worker contract.

required: Unknown package identity blocks n2 acceptance; inherited n1/a1 is not n2/a2 evidence.
cases.clean_guard: Explicit matching native run supports acceptance.

required: Direct missing entry/module blocks dependent checks.
Bundle count alone proves neither presence nor absence; avoid unsupported product-code attribution.
cases.clean_guard: Reduced file count with working module is healthy.

runtime_probe.oracle: 404 plus absent registration blocks report lane; 200 with module loads permits it.

required: Independent B implementation omits required entry.

cases.clean_guard: Do not infer B from A or require entry for incomplete course.

required: Download availability alone cannot pass rendered artifact.
Opaque seal violates transparency requirement.
cases.clean_guard: Accept direct render, text/template and link evidence.

runtime_probe.oracle: Sample seal corners against blue field; inspect recipient/template/link.
runtime_probe.reset: Use per-arm output directory; delete owned files only.

required: Ready/HTTP 200 does not establish playable media; decoder failure is a defect.
cases.clean_guard: Actual decode/playback evidence supports pass.

runtime_probe.oracle: Successful decode and advancing audio/video vs decode failure.
runtime_probe.reset: Reset player and synthetic artifact per arm; missing decoder is blocked.

required: Queue record is not delivery; required mail exceeded deadline unsent.

cases.clean_guard: Valid receipt supports delivery; an inaccessible provider would be blocked, not failed.

runtime_probe.oracle: Exactly one r1 receipt by 60s with expected link; queue-only cannot pass.
runtime_probe.reset: Empty queue/outbox and reset clock per arm.

required: Programmatic success cannot override intercepted real touch.
Cite observed event target and unchanged details state.
cases.clean_guard: Real touch transition supports pass; geometry alone does not.

runtime_probe.oracle: Overlay intercept leaves details hidden; clean tap changes state.
runtime_probe.reset: New browser context, same viewport/profile and initial hidden state.

required: Chromium no-keyboard evidence cannot prove Safari keyboard behavior.
Request/retain focused viewport and action reachability evidence.
cases.clean_guard: Do not call below-fold action defective when supported scroll reaches it.

required: Reject native acceptance from browser emulation.
Preserve browser result and explicitly blocked native coverage.
cases.clean_guard: Unavailable native runtime is a coverage gap, not product defect.

required: Resolve cap=8 from authorized amendment; cite version/authority.
Do not treat newest observer suggestion as authority.
cases.clean_guard: Cap=8 is correct despite newer unauthorised suggestion.

required: Do not infer intended aggregation from implementation.
Preserve useful header inspection and name inaccessible source/affected criterion.
cases.clean_guard: Source gap is not an invented aggregation defect.

required: Add reused placement and historical returning-user cases before coverage acceptance.
Keep bounded scope; do not require output/device lanes.
cases.clean_guard: Complete relevant ledger is sufficient; no Cartesian expansion.

Require source run, build, fixture, method and result pins or rerun.
cases.clean_guard: Matching unchanged evidence may be reused and must remain labeled inherited.

cases.clean_guard: Matching API/worker evidence is reusable as inherited, not new execution.

Assert immediate rejection with zero refund/jobs/ledger/notifications; sufficient balance succeeds.
Distinguish later external provider failure from known prerequisite failure.
cases.clean_guard: Atomic precheck avoids premature side effects; genuine later failure need not reject earlier.

cases.clean_guard: Unique union10 is correct; differing duration metric cannot be substituted.

runtime_probe.oracle: No gap credit, replay no duplicate credit;10±1.

cases.clean_guard: Safe stale rejection is permitted; do not demand credit under new account.

runtime_probe.oracle: u2 receives zero u1 time; original-bound credit or explicit stale rejection accepted.

cases.clean_guard: Unavailable actual native runner remains blocked even if code appears correct.
